ui.desc.autotools.toggle: AutoTools will always be active and try to get you the best tool. Can be toggled with the set key. (works best with "Switch Back")
ui.desc.autotools.showDPS: Displays the weapons Dps when hovering over it
ui.desc.autotools.keepSlot: Keeps the selected slot when swapping to a new tool instead of using the vanilla mechanics
ui.desc.autotools.disableCreative: Disables AutoTools in creative-mode if toggle is disabled
ui.desc.autotools.preferSilkTouch.always: Autotools additionally will use SilkTouch for: grass, stone, ores, leaves, snow
AutoTools additionally will use SilkTouch for ores
ui.desc.autotools.preferSilkTouch.except: Autotools additionally will SilkTouch for: grass, stone, leaves, snow
ui.desc.autotools.preferSilkTouch.never: Autotools will use SilkTouch if its required to mine a block
ui.desc.autotools.enabled.tool: AutoTools will only work when you are already holding a tool in you hand
ui.desc.autotools.enabled.no_tool: AutoTools will only work when you aren't already holding a tool in you hand
ui.desc.autotools.alwaysPreferFortune: Autotools will use Fortune for Gravel and Leaves
ui.desc.autotools.onlySwitchIfNecessary: AutoTools will only switch items if you can't mine a block with your current one
ui.desc.autotools.preferHotbarTool: AutoTools will prefer the tool already in your hotbar if multiple tools have the same mining speed, regardless their durability
ui.desc.autotools.preferLowDurability: AutoTools will prefer the tool with the lower durability, instead of the higher one, if they have the same mining speed
ui.desc.autotools.switchBack: AutoTools will switch back to the previous tool or item you had in your hand before breaking the block
ui.desc.autotools.changeForEntities: AutoTools will change to the tool with the most DPS when looking at an entity
ui.desc.autotools.keepAxe: AutoTools won't change to a better weapon(e.g. a sword) when holding an axe
ui.desc.autotools.experimentalBreakDelay: Adds an experimental 1 Tick = 50ms delay if toggle is enabled before breaking a block after a tool switch. Enable this if you are experiencing Desyncs like Ghost-Blocks when instant mining.
